inputs.name: x
inputs.provenance: layer-1 input = h1_cpu, the fp16 handoff of the CPU chain (tools/chain_two_layer.sh REPLACES this file with layer 0's device out_device.bin before the board run)

reference_note: golden/expected.bin is an independent numpy float32 forward pass over the stored fp16 weights/inputs/tables; it shares no code with the flatbuffer writer (which contains no maths). A float64 rerun gives 7119/7168 identical fp16 codes (max|f32-f64| = 2.441e-04), so the reference is not precision-limited.

tolerance_revision.policy: NOTES 4 / 10.1: atol = rtol = max(k*2^-11*max|out|, k*floor), k=4; the propagation allowance enters through floor_chain (see basis). The own-error criterion B uses self_atol = self_rtol = max(k*2^-11*max|out|, k*floor_self).
tolerance_revision.basis: max|h2| = 1.2676; the fp16 ULP at that magnitude is 0.0009766 (7.70e-04 relative). Device-independent floor = 6.3534e-03 abs = 6.51 ULP = 5.01e-03 relative, taken as max(floor_self=4.5166e-03, floor_chain=6.3534e-03): floor_self is this layer's own fp16 rounding floor (numpy chain with a fp16 rounding at EVERY tensor boundary vs the single-rounding golden -- what MDLA does, docs/OP-qkv.md 5.2), floor_chain is how far this layer's reference moves when it is fed the fp16-rounded previous-layer output instead of the exact one, i.e. the propagation the board handoff must introduce, estimated from numpy only. Registered atol = rtol = max(4*2^-11*max|out|, 4*floor) = 0.0254135; the 4*floor term dominates. NOTES 4's flat 2e-2 would be 1.58e-02 relative here, i.e. tighter than the measured floor (unusable). No device measurement entered this number.
tolerance_revision.self_policy: comparison B (CPU reference rebuilt from the board's own input, i.e. this layer's own error with the propagation removed) is judged against self_atol = self_rtol = max(k*2^-11*max|out|, k*floor_self), registered here before any device run.

top1.why: ADR 0003: under frozen random weights top-1 carries no semantics and one fp16 ULP flips near-ties, so argmax is not a criterion. Frozen until the real-weight stage. This ticket compares the logits VECTOR only.

eps_register.note: Qwen2.5 rms_norm_eps = 1e-6, as in ticket 09; it is numerically unobservable at this dynamic range (ticket 09 section 7 measured eps=0 vs 1e-6 at 0.20x threshold)

rope.coherence: both layers use the identical table (same THETA, POS0, T)

chain.handoff: device out_device.bin is copied over the next op's golden/input.bin (NOTES 10.4 item 5); no CPU correction in between
chain.weights_reload: each layer is its own .dla, so the whole static weight block is pushed and loaded again per layer

rows.tensor: norm gammas + qkv biases + zero FC biases
